title: 19-BCV-005 - Insulation below a heated floor

facts.text: The variance addresses insulation beneath a heated floor in contact with the ground, discussing hydronic/radiant heating as its context.
It specifies minimum under-slab RSI 0.88 (R-5) when the heated floor is fully below the frost line and RSI 1.32 (R-7.5) when it is above the frost line.
The source states that the alternative does not remove the Section 9.36 insulation requirement.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.
